hypothesis_title: Residual-momentum orthogonal diversifier sleeve vs single-sleeve R05
alpha_summary: 현 book(R05 100%, value/consensus/earnings-stability)에 return-직교(ret_cor -0.061)한 residual-momentum(M08+M14) sleeve. 직교성은 확보, standalone 강도는 약함(portfolio-alpha t 1.46 < 2.95). 용도 = optimizer multi-sleeve diversifier + DPL feature.

factor_specs.formula: cross-sectional residual of 12-1m return after market/industry beta projection (Blitz-Huij-Martens 2011 residual momentum)
factor_specs.economic_rationale: behavioral underreaction to firm-specific information; residualizing removes market/size loadings that drive correlation with value-heavy R05 -> orthogonality. KR: raw momentum IC~0 but residual/risk-adj retains modest positive ICIR.
references: Blitz, Huij, Martens (2011) JEF Residual Momentum

factor_specs.formula: trailing return scaled by realized volatility (risk-adjusted momentum)
factor_specs.economic_rationale: vol-scaling stabilizes momentum payoff, reduces crash exposure; complements residual momentum.

diagnostics.portfolio_alpha_t_note: canonical-screen (NOT forge-authoritative). rank-IC t와 명확히 구분 — long-only top-20 실현 alpha t.
diagnostics.redundancy_cluster_id: momentum_residual_KR (distinct from R05 value/consensus cluster; return-orthogonal -0.06)

orthogonality.interpretation: 낮은(음의) return correlation = R05와 직교. alpha_inheritance_cor << 0.95 -> discovery role card 정합.

challenge_flags.note: portfolio-alpha t 1.461 < graduation hard hurdle 2.95. standalone deployment 불가. diversifier/DPL feature 용도로만 honest.
DSR(n_trials=8)=0.337 < 0.5. 8후보 다중검정 보정 후 천장. 단 단일가설(n_trials=1) 0.992 -> discovery 검증 1건이면 multiple-testing 보정 부적용(measurement-graduation 2026-05-31 mandate).
rank-IC ICIR 0.095 < 0.20 advisory gate. residual momentum의 cross-sectional 신호 약함. 실현 portfolio-alpha(t 1.46)가 rank-IC보다 강한 역방향 발산 — 신호가 top-20 long에 집중.

request.json 제안 후보 CR07(crowding-conditional defensive) 실측 반증: bad-regime IC -0.041, portfolio-alpha t -2.26, AX-001 v2 conditional defense FAIL. alpha source에서 제외, risk-research crowding 진단으로 핸드오프 권고.
